objects.description: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used SSH to move laterally in victim environments and to access the vSphere vCenter Server GUI.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)
